facts.fact: Habari Daily reports the finance ministry's Lugoloobi saying IRAS, a digital revenue system, has been rolled out to all 176 local governments and holds 3,101,290 registered taxpayers, with bills, payments and arrears recorded.

Habari Daily reports the finance ministry's Lugoloobi saying IRAS, a digital revenue system, has been rolled out to all 176 local governments, giving them a common database that reports to the centre.
IRAS is rolled out to all 176 local governments, per the finance ministry cited by Habari Daily.
IRAS was rolled out to all 176 local governments in the year to mid-2026 and local own-source revenue rose 15% to Shs442.64 billion, per Habari Daily.
